Definition: to scatter, whether in enmity or bounty
BiblicalUsage: 1) to scatter, disperse; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to scatter; 1a2) scattered (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be scattered; 1c) (Piel) to scatter; 1d) (Pual) to be scattered
